events.name: Inexplicable commotion
events.desc: A huge commotion right outside your window catches your attention.

events.name: Dragon...falls?
events.desc: As the construct falls apart, some very angry festival-goers approach you. Apparently you 'attacked a parade float' and 'disrupted the festivities'. You choose to beat a hasty retreat, but not before grabbing a souvenir.

clashes.name: Dragon attacking
clashes.desc: An enormous dragon is attacking the town! Get out there and fight it before it gets to you!

clashes.name: Strativax attacking
clashes.desc: Somehow, Strativax returned! Get out there and fight it before it gets to you!

monsters.name: Strativax
monsters.desc: An enormous dragon, wreathed in dancing flames stands before you. It might be hopeless.
